Ventureneer specializes in defining and eliminating problems that hold underrepresented entrepreneurs back through research, training, and content. 

Our research raises awareness of the trends and greater challenges women and minorities entrepreneurs face. We produced The Wells Fargo Impact of Women-Owned Business and The Impact of
Women-Owned Businesses’ Capital Access, Diversity in
Venture Capital: Challenges and Opportunities for New York City for NYC Economic Development Corporation, How Women (and Men) Invest in Startups for How Women Invest,a VC firm, the Hispanic Women Entrepreneurship: Understanding Diversity Among Hispanic Women Entrepreneurs for the National Women’s Business Council, and Stand Out In The Crowd: How Women (And Men) Benefit From Equity Crowdfunding for Dell. 

Our research informs the curriculum we have developed and implemented for Baruch College, The New School, NYU Continuing Education, GreaterNY and NYC Small Business Services, Dell, and the Tory Burch Fellows programs. Projects for NYC Small Business Services include facilitating FastTrac NewVenture and GrowthVenture classes, implementing a business pitch competition in collaboration with Capital One. and overseeing M/WBE Mentor Mentors program. 

Research also informs the content we produce. We have written books, and whitepapers, including Forget the Glass Ceiling: Build Your Business Without One, Impact with Wings: Stories to Inspire and Mobilize Women Angel Investors and Entrepreneurs (contributing the chapter on the numbers), and Scaling Impact: A Primer for Nonprofits, writing articles for Forbes, Inc, Entrepreneur, Capital One, CNBC, Quickbooks, turnstone, and WE NYC. Geri Stengel, Ventureneer's president, is best known for writing in Forbes about the success factors of women entrepreneurs and a Substack newsletter -- Women's Health & Market Visibility.

rows.business_description:
CO Adaptive Architecture was founded in 2011 in New York City by Ruth Mandl and Bobby Johnston. Amidst an industry that is highly predicated on the finished image of architecture, we want to turn the focus to the means of making and maintaining it. We believe it is our responsibility as architects to understand the design of one building as part of a holistic system whose component parts have an effect on the environment they sit within. We specialize in retrofitting existing building stock to create energy-efficient and climate-resilient environments, with the goal of extending the lifespans of these buildings for many decades to come. We feel this is not only the best way to celebrate our cities’ history, but also to minimize our collective carbon footprint.
When retrofitting, we are passionate about creating quiet, comfortable and high-performance interiors, ensuring that the building is not using more energy than it can produce on site. We are attentive to the durability, health and embodied energy of materials that we use; consciously specifying materials that are local in origin, and store carbon rather than emit it in their making. It matters that materials are as simple as possible in their constitution and are produced without harm to the environment or the people making them. In our mind, care for the parts translates to a healthy whole. As such, our practice places importance on those aspects generally hidden from view in a finished project, emphasizing the past and future journeys of the ingredients as they come together. Often, the best materials to use are those that already exist. To that end, we accentuate local reuse in our projects, reintegrating and reviving found elements of the buildings we renovate.
We are strong believers that architecture is a process rather than an end result; it should be a collaborative practice that works to solve today’s biggest challenges—and does this by building upon the past rather than reinventing it.

CO Adaptive has won numerous awards for their work, and been recognized as a Design Vanguard by Architectural Record, featured as a Next Progressive by ARCHITECT Magazine, and is show-cased in the inaugural exhibition Architecture Now: New York, New Publics at The Museum of Modern Art, which was on view from February through July 2023.

rows.business_description:
EdgeworthBox, Inc., doing business as Sextant AI, develops procurement and supply chain software and provides related data integration, analytics, and digital transformation advisory services. Our business has evolved from collaborative purchasing technology to a broader platform that helps organizations improve supply chain visibility, coordinate decisions, and manage operational risk.

Our existing procurement platform supports collaboration among buyers, internal stakeholders, and suppliers, including developing statements of work, soliciting bids, and evaluating proposals. Our AI procurement assistant helps teams gather stakeholder requirements and prepare procurement documents. Through Sextant Ready, we offer assessments of supply chain data quality, technology readiness, and implementation risks. These assessments help clients evaluate vendors and systems integrators and identify gaps in new, existing, or stalled technology projects.

We are developing a shared supply chain ontology—a common structure for organizing data, defining business concepts, and connecting information across organizations and software systems. AI agents integrate, map, validate, and maintain customer data within this structure, with human oversight. This foundation supports AI-enabled workflows for demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and supply chain planning, allowing organizations to work with information from different systems using consistent definitions and metrics.

Building on this foundation, we are developing a marketplace for supply chain intelligence and risk management contracts. The marketplace is designed to let participants purchase specific information from supply chain partners while allowing information providers to control what they share. It is also intended to facilitate commercial arrangements such as guaranteed capacity commitments, revenue-sharing agreements, and supplier-managed inventory. These capabilities are designed to reduce uncertainty, improve coordination of supply and demand, and help organizations manage exposure to disruptions, inventory shortages, and excess capacity.

Our business model combines professional service and implementation fees, subscriptions for the shared data layer and associated workflows, and planned transaction fees for marketplace activity. We serve procurement and supply chain teams and are expanding our focus to manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and other organizations that depend on reliable information across their supplier and customer networks.

rows.business_description: Like Minded Software is founded on the vision that software needs to be functional as well as easy to use and manage. In addition, our extreme focus on our clients will ensure that we align our work with the strategic and functional requirements of the businesses we serve. We are a team of like minded professionals with a deep technical understanding of the discipline that we work in. We provide full software development life cycle services. As part of this, we provide staff augmentation and project based development services. We have a combined total of 30+ years of development experience. We are constantly trying to stay with the latest standards in development technologies. We are committed to the open nature of enterprise standards. This allows us to deploy our work across a range of platforms i.e. Windows, Apache etc. With this in mind, we will have created a collection of framework components that are highly repurposeable. This not only expedites development time but it also makes our process of iterative development and continuous integration possible. During execution, we only need to focus on project specific functionality. It also supports our view that requirements change and unless the client sees what we are developing, the requirements are difficult to define. Our software implementation methodology is highly iterative. We believe in a show and tell approach to completing projects. However, we are adaptable to the specific requirements of the project. In doing so, we have combined a structured manner of collecting requirements and then organizing sprints to deliver the agreed to functionality. We build in the project controls as part of the implementation methodology. The project controls ensure that our efforts are aligned with the scope, schedule and budget for the project. The controls include project management, change management, risk/issue management and project reporting.

We also support non-profits including The Women’s Education Project, Citta, GirlUp, New York Cares and the American Indian Foundation.

rows.business_description:
Inclusive Communication Services (ICS) is dedicated to providing professional-quality accessibility services that cater to the diverse communication needs of individuals who are Deaf, hard-of-hearing, DeafBlind, blind, low-vision, non-English speaking, and limited English proficient (LEP). Each service request is managed by a designated accessibility coordinator with extensive professional expertise in accessibility, ensuring top-quality service delivery. Our comprehensive suite of services includes:

**Sign Language Interpreting**: We offer a wide range of sign language interpreting services to bridge communication gaps for the Deaf and hard-of-hearing community. Our offerings include:
- American Sign Language (ASL)
- British Sign Language (BSL)
- Mexican Sign Language (LSM)
- French Sign Language (LSF)
- And over 50 other sign language varieties

**Spoken Language Interpreting**: Our spoken language interpreting services facilitate effective communication for non-English speaking and LEP individuals. We cover:
- Spanish
- French
- Mandarin Chinese
- Haitian Creole
- Vietnamese
- Arabic
- Bengali
- German
- Hindi
- Italian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Portuguese
- Russian
- Turkish
- Urdu
- And over 150 other languages.

**Document and Media Translation**: Ensuring accuracy and accessibility, we provide translation services for a variety of content types:
- Legal documents
- Video content
- Educational courses
- Articles
- Court evidence
- And more

**Live Captioning**: For real-time access to spoken content, our live captioning services include:
- Communication Access Realtime Translation (CART)
- TypeWell captioning

**Subtitling**: Enhance the accessibility of your video and audio content with our reliable and accurate subtitling services, available in over 200 languages.

**Voiceover & Dubbing**: Make your multimedia content accessible to non-English speakers through our professional quality voiceover and audio dubbing services.

**Audio Description (AD)**: Ensure your video content and live events are accessible to the blind and low-vision community with our detailed audio description services.

**Braille & Large Print Transcription**: We offer transcription and printing services to convert visual content, media, and documents into braille and large print formats, making them accessible to the blind and low-vision community.

Inclusive Communication Services is committed to fostering equal access and inclusion across all communities. Whether it's sign language interpreting for a medical appointment, real-time captioning for a webinar, or translating legal documents, we ensure that our services meet the highest standards of quality and accuracy. Contact us today to learn more about how we can support your accessibility needs and promote inclusive communication for all.

We follow a clear investment philosophy and disciplined process which results in high conviction portfolios designed to deliver consistent, long term performance in excess of benchmarks. rows.business_description:
Our Background
At Indigo River we're proud of who we are, and proud of what we do. We're not one thing, we're many things: visionaries, architects, engineers, artists, technologists, planners, futurists, athletes, programmers, musicians, partners, nature enthusiasts, and human beings. We draw inspiration for our innovative design services from our interdisciplinary experiences.
We are passionate about designing the future. We believe that design creates culture, that culture shapes values, and that values determine the future. We are a New York-based transdisciplinary design studio focused on creating sustainable and resilient solutions that have a positive impact on tomorrow's world.
Founded on the belief that design has the power to transform lives and enhance communities, we collaborate with clients to create healthy, sustainable places, often at the water’s edge, in which to live, learn, work, play, and heal. Clients consistently turn to us for our leadership and expertise in areas like marine & waterfront design, sustainability, resilience, and wellness. Indigo River is a woman-owned design consultancy committed to helping our society evolve. Our design solutions respond to local conditions yet retain universal values.

Our Vision
We are faced with inconvenient truths: climate change, hyper-urbanization, and rising economic and social challenges. Transdisciplinary Design has the power to organize ideas, raise awareness, and enable action towards global goals. A vision for our future, one project at a time.

Our Mission
As we enter the Fourth Industrial Revolution, defined by technologies which fuse the physical, digital, and biological worlds, we believe that now, more than ever, da single idea can have a butterfly effect -- that each project can create global impact. It's what drives our mission to create sustainable, resilient, progressive solutions for tomorrow's world.

Our Solution
As an Integrated Design Practice, we have the expertise and personnel to blur the lines between Architecture, Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Marine Engineering, Planning, and Construction.  Unlike many design firms, we focus on seamlessly blending the disciplines together as a part of our overall process. We staff our project teams with members well-versed in each discipline, assuring the overall design, inside and out, is integrated and unified, for stellar execution. We design solutions that transcend boundaries.

rows.business_description:
Chemistry Creative is a multi-disciplinary production company located in Brooklyn, NY that partners with artists, brands and agencies, to create compelling digital content and unconventional live experiences. We’re artist-owned and operated and truly believe that we can make the world a better place by incorporating innovative creativity in everything we do.

The company was founded in 2012 by Pete Sax, a musician and filmmaker who worked in live technical production throughout the early 2000s to support his creative pursuits. After realizing there was an unmet demand for quality, multi-disciplinary creative production services in the New York market, Pete launched Chemistry Creative. After some initial success, Pete began hiring other creatives seeking respectable and gainful employment as they pursued their artistic endeavors—giving them the tools and training they needed to participate in the formal economy. 

By 2013, Chemistry had built its own photo and video studio, scenic design and fabrication shop, and event space in East Williamsburg, Brooklyn. In the years to follow, Chemistry grew its eclectic staff and took on large scenic builds and complex interactive experiences, working with some of the most recognized brands in the world including: Sony, Nike, Kanye West, Under Armour, Reebok and more.
